# Biscuit's tail: a curled tube of three segments, its root at the origin (the pivot it flicks on),
# lying along +X. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Fur --base-color 1.0000 0.5020 0.0000 --no-slot
material new Tip --base-color 1.0000 0.7529 0.5020 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name T0 --size 1 --location 0.0600 0.0000 0.0250
scale 0.1200 0.0500 0.0500
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name T1 --size 1 --location 0.16 -0.04 0.025
scale 0.1 0.05 0.05
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -35
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name T2 --size 1 --location 0.21 -0.11 0.025
scale 0.09 0.05 0.05
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -75
apply --rotation
select T0 T1
material assign Fur
select T2
material assign Tip
select T0 T1 T2
active T0
join
shade flat
export tail.glb
